column1: # Venus Lighthouse Aerie: the collapse, Sheba's fall, Felix's sacrifice and the party's return.

column3: We did everything\nwe could.{end_wait}
We failed to save\nVenus Lighthouse, but...{end_wait}
We beat them! They fell\ninto the pit below...{end_wait}
At least no one can\nuse them to awaken\nanother beacon.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:5} is gone,\nand he has taken\n{actor_name:7} with him...{end_wait}
What is wrong with you?\n{actor_name:1}, what are you\nstaring at?{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Did you{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} finish them?{end_wait}

I knew their strength
better than anyone.{page_break}If you overcame them,
then I have no reason
to challenge you.{end_wait}
I cannot oppose you\nnow, {actor_name:1}...{page_break}I must leave.{end_wait}
Come, {actor_name:7}!{end_wait}
Wait, {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Why do you run from us?{end_wait}
They fell into the\nlighthouse. It is over!{end_wait}
Fools...{pause_20_skippable} If you believe\nthis is finished, you\nhave learned nothing.{end_wait}
If you intend to awaken\nthe remaining beacons,\nyou will still need...{end_wait}
The Elemental Stars?\nWe have them with us!{end_wait}
They're gone, {actor_name:5}!\nYou no longer need to\nawaken the beacons...{end_wait}
I must.{pause_20_skippable} If I do not\nawaken the beacons...{end_wait}
What will happen?{end_wait}
Words will change\nnothing...{pause_20_skippable}\nWait and see.{end_wait}
If you refuse to release\n{actor_name:7}, we will\nbring her back ourselves!{end_wait}
The lighthouse...!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{pause_20_skippable} They are too\nfar away! We cannot reach\n{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Look below! There is\nlight rising from the\nfoundations!{end_wait}
No!{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:7}! Hold on!{end_wait}
Hold on, {actor_name:7}!\nTake my hand!{end_wait}
I can't...{end_wait}
You have to try!\nKeep your grip or\nyou will fall!{end_wait}
Look down...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} The\nlighthouse foundations\nare breaking apart!{end_wait}
Why is this happening?\nIs the power trying to\nprotect Venus Lighthouse?{end_wait}
I'm{pause_20_skippable} slipping...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nI cannot{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} hold on{pause_20_skippable}\nany longer.{end_wait}
No!{pause_20_skippable} Don't let go!\nYou'll fall!{end_wait}
Farewell, {actor_name:5},{pause_20_skippable}\n{pause_20_skippable} and thank you.{end_wait}
{text_effect:2}{actor_name:7}!!!{reset_text_style}{pause_20_skippable} No!\nI will not let you die!{end_wait}
!!!{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} fell after\nthat final tremor...{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} did not dive\nafter her, did he?{end_wait}
I cannot believe he\nleapt from that height!{end_wait}
Fool, {actor_name:5}!{pause_20_skippable} I cannot\nbelieve he still meant\nto awaken the beacons.{end_wait}
We might have fought\nhim if the ground had\nnot broken...{end_wait}
But he risked his life\nto save {actor_name:7}. He is\nnot like Saturos.{end_wait}
I'm lost, {actor_name:1}.\nWe must decide what\nto do now.{end_wait}
What choice is left?{pause_20_skippable}\nWhat {text_effect:2}can{reset_text_style} we do?{end_wait}
What about {actor_name:6} and\nthe others at Idejima?{end_wait}
Right!{pause_20_skippable} I forgot about\n{actor_name:6}!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! Listen!{pause_20_skippable}\nWe must find {actor_name:6}!{end_wait}
Look!{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:1} has finally\ncome back to himself!{end_wait}
Should we go find\n{actor_name:6} and the others\nright away?{end_now}
At last, you agree\nwith me!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you must tell\n{actor_name:6} what happened\nto {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
It will hurt her, but\nshe will need you\nbeside her.{end_wait}
After all this, you\ncannot face {actor_name:6}\nor tell her of {actor_name:5}?{end_wait}
If you will not tell\nher what happened to\n{actor_name:5}, who will?{end_wait}
You must find a way\nto help {actor_name:6} bear\nthe truth...{end_wait}
What's wrong, {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
I was thinking...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nHow are we meant to\nclimb down from here?{end_wait}
You're right.{pause_20_skippable} Getting away\nfrom this place will be\ndifficult...{end_wait}
It's back to normal!{end_wait}
That was strange...\nWhat is happening\naround here?{end_wait}
Perhaps we will\nnever know.{end_wait}
At least we can search\nfor {actor_name:6} and\nthe others now.{end_wait}
All right{pause_20_skippable}, let's move,\n{actor_name:1}!{pause_20_skippable} We must find\n{actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
After a long and weary\nsearch, {actor_name:6} was\nnowhere to be found.{end_wait}
